# CURSED Moderation Dashboard Upgrade Scope

This branch is restricted to moderation and server-security dashboard changes only: manual moderation, AutoMod, anti-raid, anti-nuke, quarantine, lockdown, cases, audit logs, staff safety controls, and the API proxies/types required by those pages.

Explicitly out of scope: AI, economy, tickets, welcome, autorole, games, profiles, server switching, authentication, deployment architecture, and unrelated refactors.
